evals.prompt: Grill me on my plan to add GitHub OAuth login to our internal ASP.NET app. We have local accounts today, HR wants SSO this quarter, and I have not thought through edge cases yet.
evals.expected_output: The skill should interrogate requirements, security constraints, rollout concerns, fallback behavior, and operational details until the plan is clearer, while recommending sensible defaults where appropriate.

evals.prompt: I want to reorganize our Copilot plugin marketplace repo so each plugin has better docs and release hygiene. Grill me before I start changing folders around.
evals.expected_output: The skill should walk through repo structure, release process, compatibility, naming, migration risks, and success criteria rather than letting the user jump straight into edits.

evals.prompt: Please grill me on this API rewrite idea: replace our Node service with Go, keep the same REST contract, and finish before Black Friday. I mostly have gut feel, not a real plan.
evals.expected_output: The skill should expose missing delivery assumptions, performance goals, staffing realities, rollout strategy, testing needs, and cutover risk while helping the user sharpen the plan.
